events.title: William M. King et al., Heirs at Law of James Turnbull, Deceased, Plaintiff in Error, vs. Ario Pardee, Edward Roberts, et al., Executors of A. S. Roberts, Deceased, Edward Roberts, J’r, et al. 1877: Vol 173
events.acquired_text_excerpt:
I entered upon the property under this lease. We went on and 
did the work necessary to open a mine, drove a drain, erected a 
breaker, and commenced shipping coal; so much work went on. 
Roberts was busy putting up houses, building R. R. I can’t say 
how many houses were built in one and two years, perhaps twenty. 
Houses have been put up ever since, as the work required. Now 
nearly one hundred houses; there were one hundred, but four were 
burned. There are now ninety-five houses for workmen. Ther 
are two on John Kunkle, ninety-five on Mary Kunkle. In spring 
of 1847 Roberts built a hk. R. from Hazleton to the Mary Kunkle
